title: Exact pullback and localized resolution augmentations
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal A'$ be abelian categories with enough injectives, equipped with derived categories and their bounded below full subcategories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Let $L:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A'$ be additive and exact, meaning that it preserves finite limits and finite colimits [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let $Y\in\mathcal A$, and let $s:Y[0]\to I$ and $t:(LY)[0]\to J$ be its chosen injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Suppose $\varphi:LI\to J$ is a chain map and $L(s);\varphi$ is homotopic to $\sigma_Y;t$, where $\sigma_Y:L(Y[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}(LY)[0]$ is the canonical single-complex comparison. Denote the augmentations inverted in $D^+$ by $a_Y:Y[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}QI$ and $a_{LY}:(LY)[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$. Write $L_D$ for the exact functor induced on $D^+$, $\lambda_I:L_D(QI)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(LI)$ for its canonical factorization, and $\sigma^D_Y:L_D(Y[0])\xrightarrow{\sim}(LY)[0]$ for its canonical single-complex comparison. Then $L_D(a_Y);\lambda_I;Q(\varphi)=\sigma^D_Y;a_{LY}$. All comparisons are the canonical ones defined by mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh, mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor, and the fully faithful inclusion's preimage of the localized augmentation.

proof.text:
Apply the fully faithful inclusion from D+ to D. Its image of a and a'
is the single-complex comparison followed by Q of the respective augmentation
and the inverse quotient/Qh comparison. The image of the exact-functor
factorization is mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh on the resolution. Expand it into
the Q factorization and cancel the adjacent quotient/Qh comparisons.
Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors along the augmentation moves L past
that augmentation. Expand mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor; its final inverse
single-complex comparison cancels the first comparison in a'. Both sides now
have the same initial single-complex comparison and exact-functor factorization.
The remaining equality is Q(L(ι') ≫ φ) = Q(singleMap.hom ≫ ι'). It follows from
the supplied homotopy, since Q identifies homotopic maps. Faithfulness gives
the original equality. No preservation of injective objects is used; no separate quasi-isomorphism hypothesis on φ is needed. Zero objects and zero complexes satisfy the same
calculation.

lean.statement: theorem resolution_pullback_augmentation {A A' : Type*} [Category* A] [Category* A'] [Abelian A] [Abelian A'] [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory A'] [EnoughInjectives A] [EnoughInjectives A'] (L : A ⥤ A') [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L] (Y : A) (φ : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (injectiveResolution Y).cochainComplex ⟶ (injectiveResolution (L.obj Y)).cochainComplex) (hφ : Nonempty (Homotopy ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (injectiveResolution Y).ι' ≫ φ) ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex L (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app Y ≫ (injectiveResolution (L.obj Y)).ι'))) : let I : CochainComplex.Plus A := ⟨(injectiveResolution Y).cochainComplex, 0, inferInstance⟩ let J : CochainComplex.Plus A' := ⟨(injectiveResolution (L.obj Y)).cochainComplex, 0, inferInstance⟩ let LI : CochainComplex.Plus A' := ⟨(L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I.obj, 0, inferInstance⟩ let a := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimageIso (X := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor A 0).obj Y) (Y := DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj I) ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ A 0).app Y ≪≫ asIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (injectiveResolution Y).ι') ≪≫ (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso A).symm.app _) let a' := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.preimageIso (X := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor A' 0).obj (L.obj Y)) (Y := DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj J) ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ A' 0).app (L.obj Y) ≪≫ asIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (injectiveResolution (L.obj Y)).ι') ≪≫ (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso A').symm.app _) L.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map a.hom ≫ L.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh.hom.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient A).obj I) ≫ DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.map (ObjectProperty.homMk φ : LI ⟶ J) = (L.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y ≫ a'.hom
